title: Provisional Name Headings
summary: Name headings established as "provisional" (coded c in 008/33) because of inadequate information may be assigned as subject headings without further action. If the work provides enough information to establish the heading fully, the heading may be revised.
validation_rules: A name heading coded "provisional" (value `c` in 008/33) is valid for assignment as a subject heading as established, without further action. (H 436)
If the work being cataloged contains information enabling the heading to be fully established, consider revising the provisional heading (or requesting a descriptive cataloger to do so). (H 436)
